intro: Betrayal from Within is a task offered by Mangletooth, an imprisoned quilboar held in a cage at Camp Taurajo. Spurned and left for dead by his own kin, Mangletooth seeks bloody vengeance against the trio of Razormane warlords who emerged from Razorfen Kraul to organize assaults across the Barrens.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Three of my tribe came out of the Kraul to lead the raids against the Horde, traveler. They are ruthless and cunning, and if you defeat them, then your Crossroads and even most of the Barrens will learn peace... At least from the Razormane tribe.

Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane are the ones you seek. They are far to the south of the Barrens. One is a spell caster, another a tracker, and their leader, the one called Orcbane, a warrior. Kill them, traveler, like they have killed me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Thork thinks he knows the truth about who leads the raids against his people, but he shall learn how wrong he is if you are successful.
My death is inescapable, but you have caused great pain to my enemies, so Mangletooth regrets nothing.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is done then. Better it ends this way, says Mangletooth. They should have made sure I was dead when they turned their backs on me instead of leaving me here in this forsaken cage.
There is but one task left for you to finish, traveler.
